name: Eleanor Wickes
source:
Eleanor commonly goes by the nickname Ellie. 

She is the newly hired legal assistant to Robert Oakwood. 

Ellie is one of the main romance options for Robert Oakwood.

Born July 20th 2000 (Game takes place in 2019).
